prompt.alinti: This Claude skill creates unlimited brand content on autopilot and yes you can grab it at the end.
So first drop in your website URL and Claude will analyze your brand and save it inside of one DNA document.
Next drop in any of your favorite visual references and Claude will break down the creative brief hiding inside that exact image.
It then will use its internal content guidelines to write an image generation prompt around your brand DNA.
The result is product visuals that look completely on brand, every time.
You can just drop in five more references and you have a week of posts.
If you want the full brand content skill just comment pink and send it straight to your DMs.
